packageRules.description: Supply-chain hardening (Art. X): wait 7 days before proposing newly published versions
Group non-major devDependency bumps into one PR
Keep the pinned pnpm packageManager field current

minimatch is held at the exact version patches/minimatch@3.1.5.patch applies to. Renovate reads pnpm-workspace overrides but NOT patchedDependencies, so it cannot see that coupling: a bump here would land a patch that no longer applies and break installs. The two move together, by hand, or not at all.
